resources.string: For Blinkit and the optional Swiggy screen-assisted fallback, Beta uses AccessibilityService only with your permission after you start a cart-building flow. Direct Swiggy MCP use does not require AccessibilityService. During a screen-assisted flow, Beta may read visible grocery app data, including product details, cart contents, buttons, prices, and delivery details such as name, precise delivery location, and address if shown, so it can build the cart you requested and stop before payment.

After you choose to start, Beta uses screen capture and AccessibilityService to read visible grocery app screens, including text, buttons, product names, prices, cart contents, and delivery details such as your name, precise delivery location, delivery address, and locality if shown. Beta sends this screen context to its backend only to build the cart you request. Beta always stops before checkout and payment. It does not place orders or pay. You can stop whenever you want. Diagnostic feedback is optional.

Beta needs Accessibility permission for Blinkit and the optional screen-assisted Swiggy fallback. Direct Swiggy connection does not need it. On the next screen, tap Beta ordering assistant and turn it on. Then come back to Beta.
